thread:
alex_cs: Heads-up — Pinegrove Analytics hit 5xx errors from EU during a sales demo at 09:12 UTC. They asked if we can spin up an EU edge and give a temporary rate bump for the demo traffic. Renewal review in ~3w, want to avoid it becoming a blocker.

raj_se: Do we have numbers? how big was the spike (qps) and which endpoints?

alex_cs: They sent logs — mostly chat generation endpoints, ~120 rps sustained for 10m with bursts to 300rps. Errors look like timeouts from eu pool. Customer asked for "eu-edge + 2x rate" for 48h.

mei_netops: We can provision eu-west-2-edge and add Pinegrove's IP ranges to the allowlist. Need the CIDR and an exact time window. If they want an immediate bump we should do a short-lived rule.

alex_cs: Asked for a same-day window (today 10:30–18:30 UTC). CIDRs provided: 34.88.12.0/22, 185.56.23.128/26.

mei_netops: Copy. i'll prepare the allowlist entry and a firewall rule. plan: create ACL rule "pinegrove-demo-5055" and apply to eu-west-2-edge.

raj_se: For the rate bump — recommend temporary QPS override on the proxy route rather than global quota change. If we do 2x for 48h and pin them to burst pool it avoids wider impact. I can set route override to 2x.

 tom_infra: I can provision a dedicated burst node group for the demo if you want <2h lead. We should log an exception and set auto-revoke for 48h. I'll open INC-4321 and tag eng-sre.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: INC-4321 — "Pinegrove demo: eu-edge allowlist + temp QPS override" by tom_infra. ETA: 90m.

alex_cs: Great — can you also add a renewal note? They explicitly said performance concerns will affect renewal decision. Marking renewal_risk: high.

mei_netops: @alex_cs done. ACL applied to eu-west-2-edge, rule id acl-9876. Please confirm customer can test.

alex_cs: Pinged customer and scheduled 10:30 UTC test. Will share curl sample for them to try.

alex_cs: curl sample I sent them:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDFOO\" \n  -d '{"model":"gptx-redwood","input":"hello"}'
```

raj_se: I'll monitor traces and token-level latency for the route. If errors persist we'll fallback them to hosted-eu replica and keep the rate limit conservative.

tom_infra: bump scheduled, burst nodes created, auto-revoke set for +48h. closing loop after verification. :thumbsup:

alex_cs: Thanks everyone. I'll capture customer feedback after demo and log in the renewal tracker. :eyes:
